item.title: Audit Flags 17 Fixes for Montclair Schools Finances as $17.6M Tax Vote Nears
item.description: An annual audit of the Montclair Public Schools presented Wednesday details 17 “recommendations” for corrective action – seven of them “material weaknesses” – including over-expenditures, losses in the food service fund and multiple issues with paying bills.
